# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

Mirach is pre-1.0 software with a single maintainer. The latest commit on
`master` is the only supported version. Older tagged releases (when they
appear) are not back-ported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not open a public issue** for security findings.

Send a private report to **josluna1098@gmail.com** with:

- A short description of the issue.
- Steps to reproduce or a proof-of-concept (if available).
- The affected component (`mirach/stt.py`, `mirach/ipc.py`, `install.py`, etc.).
- Your assessment of impact (local code execution, leaked credentials, denial
  of service, etc.).

## What to expect

This project is maintained by a single person on a best-effort basis:

- I will acknowledge receipt within a few days.
- I will work on a fix in a private branch and credit you on disclosure (or
  keep you anonymous on request).
- Once a fix lands on `master`, I will publish a brief advisory in the repo's
  Security tab.

Thank you for helping keep Mirach safe for everyone using it.
